There exists a mountain unseen, hidden amidst mist and clouds. Only a perilous cliff pass remains, connecting the realms within and beyond the Mohist Gate. Suspended in danger, few have ever crossed this pass since ancient times. In the early Kaiyun era, a swordsman from Jin named Qiu Yuehai attempted to leap over it with his lightness skill, only to exhaust himself mid-air. He sighed deeply, lamenting, "So towering and unyielding, alas!"
For ordinary folk seeking passage, they must enter the cliff pass and gain the approval of its guardian. Rumors say the current guardian is one of the Mohist Sect's Three Heroes—named Lu, renowned for her keen Perception. Upon her debut in the martial world, she swiftly rose to fame. Yet, for reasons unknown, she withdrew to guard the pass, living in seclusion. To this day, three years have passed.
